hooks.name: CREAT.md Stop Logger
hooks.description: Appends a timestamped entry to CREAT.md when each agent execution turn stops.

action.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$ts = Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'; $logLine = '| ' + $ts + ' | Agent turn completed |'; Add-Content -Path 'E:\Rajkumar\BridgeCAD-Enterprise-Suite\CREAT.md' -Value $logLine"
